history.summary: Young freehold (2020) mixed-use boutique at Upper Thomson MRT, asking $2,152 psf — ~11% above the $1,936 median — for a compact 947 sqft 3BR. Good TEL location and a 4.9%/yr resale rate, but a 12-txn series and tiny boutique liquidity make pricing and exit uncertain.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold, only 6 years old, and 410m to Upper Thomson MRT (TEL) in a trendy F&B enclave are real strengths, and the 4.9%/yr resale-only rate is healthy. But $2,152 psf is ~11% above the $1,936 URA median, the 947 sqft 3BR is a tight compact format, and the 12-txn series plus boutique scale make both fair value and resale liquidity hard to pin down.
red_flags: Thin 12-txn series — appreciation and value estimates unreliable
Boutique mixed-use block — shallow resale liquidity
catalysts: 410m to Upper Thomson MRT (Thomson-East Coast Line)
Upper Thomson F&B/lifestyle enclave supports rental demand
